items.title: Consolidated Edison Q2 Earnings Top Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: ED tops Q2 earnings and revenue estimates as higher electric and gas rate bases lift results, while reaffirming 2026 earnings guidance and investment plans.

items.summary: Con Edison reported higher second-quarter earnings as growth in its regulated electric and gas rate base lifted utility profits.

items.title: Consolidated Edison (ED) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
items.summary: Con Ed (ED) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +12.16% and +8.66%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.summary: The headline numbers for Con Ed (ED) give insight into how the company performed in the quarter ended June 2026, but it may be worthwhile to compare some of its key metrics to Wall Street estimates and the year-ago actuals.

items.title: Consolidated Edison Reports Higher Profit, Revenue
items.summary: The New York-based utility company posted a second-quarter profit of $308 million, up from $246 million a year earlier.

items.summary: SWX misses Q2 earnings and revenue estimates, but lower costs lift operating income as it advances a major Great Basin expansion.

items.title: Pinnacle West Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
